title: 'A party invitation': How Bengaluru family was massacred inside house
content: Indushekar reportedly committed the murders of his wife and six family members over two days in Bengaluru. After the initial murder of Sunita, he allegedly invited his brothers-in-law to his home, where he killed them as well. The investigation revealed that he used a grinding stone for the killings and then attempted to clean the crime scene. A missing-person report prompted police to discover the situation and arrest Indushekar.

title: Rs 29.57L cr added to investor wealth! Why Sensex, Nifty had best week in over 5 years
content: As Diwali approaches, Indian stock exchanges celebrated a remarkable boost, seeing both Sensex and Nifty climb significantly. This positive shift was driven by a hefty influx from foreign institutional investors, who recorded their highest single-day purchases in the last six years. Additionally, lower crude oil rates and a strengthened rupee enhanced market confidence.

title: Why thousands of Goldman Sachs workers can no longer use Claude Code, GitHub
content: Goldman Sachs has banned most non-technical staff, including traders and bankers, from using AI coding tools like Anthropic's Claude Code and Microsoft's GitHub, according to Bloomberg. Access is limited to engineers and strats after the bank reviewed productivity and risk concerns. The move has frustrated traders who used the tools for financial modelling and tracking client trading flows, months after its CIO praised vibe coding.

title: 'World Champion pressure is completely different': Pragg on Gukesh-Sindarov match
content: R Praggnanandhaa expects an exciting World Chess Championship battle between D Gukesh and Javokhir Sindarov, highlighting their recent form and long-standing familiarity. He also said defending the world title brings pressure he cannot fully understand without experiencing it. Meanwhile, Gukesh visited Neem Karoli Baba’s ashram ahead of the November 24 title clash in Geneva

title: Bronx home buyer demands $270,000 price cut, loses $1m lawsuit
content: A man from New York made a cash offer for a dilapidated home in the Bronx, agreeing to accept it in its current state. After finding additional issues just days before the closing, he sought a considerable price decrease. The seller declined, referring to the contract terms and previous property condition disclosures.

title: Eva Longoria-backed charity cares for over 100 children at Vietnam orphanage
content: Since 2018, the Global Gift Foundation has championed the Quang Chau Orphanage, now known as Casa Ángeles, providing care to over 100 needy children. This initiative, bolstered by funds from the Global Gift Gala in Paris, also supports the Casa Ángeles therapy centre in Spain. Through engaging performances and a vibrant auction, the event helps sustain vital projects aimed at uplifting vulnerable communities.

title: Meet Anakh Sawhney, who began feeding kids at 9, has helped over 110,000
content: New Jersey teenager Anakh Sawhney started Rice Kids in 2018, aged nine, to provide meals to hungry children. Her nonprofit has since supported more than 110,000 people across five US states and parts of India through food, education, healthcare and other essential resources. More than half of the students supported by the organisation in India have returned to mainstream education.

title: Florida’s new property tax: Why tech execs move to ‘Billionaire Bunkers’ may be right
content: Florida voters have given a green light to Amendment 3, a game-changing overhaul of property tax laws in the state. This will greatly enhance the homestead exemption, tripling it and providing crucial tax relief to average homeowners. However, for the ultra-wealthy with sprawling estates, the advantages of the exemption will seem rather insignificant.

title: Vande Bharat Sleeper trains get dedicated dog box facility for pet owners
content: The introduction of dedicated pet box facilities in Vande Bharat Sleeper trains by Indian Railways marks a significant step towards making long-distance travel easier for dog owners. To utilize this new service, passengers must hold a confirmed train ticket and can transport one pet per PNR with the required documentation. This thoughtful initiative enhances the accessibility of rail travel for families accompanied by their furry friends.

title: Patrick Mahomes and wife Brittany help 60 young women find dream dresses
content: In 2024, Patrick Mahomes and Brittany Mahomes' KC Current partnered with Nuuly and United Way of Greater Kansas City to donate nearly 100 designer dresses to local young women. The initiative welcomed 60 members of the Boys & Girls Clubs of Greater Kansas City, offering them outfits for special occasions. Players Hailie Mace, Gabrielle Robinson and Nichelle Prince also joined the event, which focused on confidence and self-expression.

title: Patrick Mahomes’ $8 million Missouri estate: Inside his eight-acre luxury compound
content: Patrick Mahomes moved his family into a custom estate in Belton, Missouri, in 2023. He purchased the land for $400,000 in September 2020 and began construction shortly afterward. The estate includes a private football field, a pool, and a gym designed for family use. Mahomes has a Texas home for the off-season, but Belton serves as the family's base during football season.

title: GRAP 3 invoked across Delhi-NCR ahead of Diwali; several areas in 'severe' zone

Delhi's average Air Quality Index was recorded at hazardous levels in multiple areas today. Municipal authorities deployed water sprinklers to control dust around India Gate and other locations. Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann faced criticism from Delhi's environment minister for misleading information about stubble burning.

title: Diwali fireworks continue as Sensex ends over 1,700 points; top reasons for rally

Global equities suffered a sharp sell-off amid fading enthusiasm for artificial intelligence (AI) stocks following US President Donald Trump’s defeat in the midterm elections.

title: Happy Choti Diwali 2026: Wishes, messages, images and quotes
content: Choti Diwali, or Naraka Chaturdashi, is the precursor to the grand Diwali festivities, celebrated to honor Lord Krishna's triumph over the wicked Narakasura. This day symbolizes new beginnings and the hope that comes with them. People partake in early morning rituals, adorn their homes, and prepare delightful sweets. Despite regional variations in customs, the festival fosters a spirit of compassion and encourages reflections on personal values and relationships.

title: Jobe Bellingham earns maiden England call-up, joins brother Jude for Nations League
content: Jobe Bellingham, the talented midfielder, has earned a spot in the England senior team for the upcoming fixtures. Joining his brother Jude, this unique family duo adds an interesting narrative to the matches against Croatia and Spain in the Nations League. After shining at Borussia Dortmund, Jobe's selection underscores his rapid ascent, while Cole Palmer and Phil Foden remain sidelined due to injuries.

title: Kenyan cult leader gets 200 years for starving 190 children to death
content: Paul Nthenge Mackenzie faces a staggering 200-year prison sentence for orchestrating the Shakahola massacre, which tragically claimed the lives of numerous church members, including 190 innocent children who reportedly starved under his directives. He manipulated his followers to believe that fasting would bring them closer to Jesus in the face of an impending apocalypse.

title: Watch: Karmabhoomi Express coaches gutted in Punjab; short-circuit suspected
content: A fire erupted in three coaches of the Karmabhoomi Express in Patiala district, Punjab on Friday around 1pm. The sudden flames instilled fear in passengers as they spread quickly. Promptly, railway officials and emergency teams arrived to manage the situation, which was likely caused by a short circuit. Fortunately, all passengers were unharmed, and alternative transportation was arranged for their continued journey.

title: 2-year ban for ‘Clicky Ponting’, England club relegated with 60-point deduction
content: Brian Devine, nicknamed "Clicky Ponting", has been banned from cricket for two years after a viral video showed him allegedly faking an edge by clicking his fingers. Saltburn CC’s second XI has also been relegated and handed a 60-point deduction. While several public figures criticised the incident, cricket commentators felt the backlash against the amateur cricketer was excessive.

title: 'She killed herself, I dumped body': Indian-origin man's on wife's murder trial in US
content: Naresh Bhatt, an Indian-origin individual, stands accused of murdering his wife, Mamta Kafle. During the trial, he claimed to have discovered her lifeless body, asserting it was a case of suicide in July 2024. However, evidence, including surveillance footage and forensic analysis, contradicts his account, revealing blood linked to Kafle. Despite the grave allegations, Bhatt asserts his innocence and pleads not guilty.

title: Delhi HC flags Doosra's violation of Ganguly's rights, orders Rs 2 crore guarantee
content: The Delhi High Court ruled that the film Doosra violated Sourav Ganguly's personality rights, compelling producers to provide a bank guarantee. Despite this, the court allowed the film to continue its theatrical release, underscoring the importance of Ganguly's rights in the narrative. Producers are mandated to add disclaimers clarifying Ganguly's lack of consent for using his persona.

title: China's helicopter arsenal grows, is India ready for the Himalayan challenge?
content: China is significantly enhancing its helicopter capabilities, focusing on new attack and transport models. The People's Liberation Army's investments could shift military balance along the Himalayan frontier against India. India, in response, is strengthening its own helicopter fleet with various indigenous and foreign platforms. Both nations are prioritizing aerial mobility for effective operations in challenging mountainous terrain. The ongoing developments highlight the evolving military dynamics between India and China.

title: Bomb threat to Amitabh Bachchan's bungalow, Bombay HC, BSE on Dhanteras
content: A bomb threat email was sent to the Bombay High Court, raising security concerns across Mumbai. Prominent locations mentioned include the Bombay Stock Exchange and Mahalaxmi Racecourse. The email also named Bollywood superstar Amitabh Bachchan's residence, Jalsa, as a potential target. Authorities are currently investigating the credibility of the threat and determining appropriate actions. Further details about this situation are expected shortly from official sources.

title: 2026 set to be second-hottest year ever recorded; El Nino yet to peak
content: The year 2026 is anticipated to be one of the warmest on record as global temperatures soar. Experts suggest that the prevailing El Niño will peak around this time, intensifying the risk of severe weather phenomena worldwide. The World Meteorological Organization warns of impending droughts and floods as a result, while projections hint that temperatures might rise even more in 2027, threatening existing climate balances.

title: Sehwag's fifty, Ishan's three-for power India to 10-wicket win in Under-19 Asia Cup
content: Aaryavir Sehwag and Lakshya Raichandani remained unbeaten as India chased down the target of 129 in just 19.1 overs, with 30.5 overs to spare. Sehwag scored 70 off 52 balls, hitting seven fours and four sixes, while Raichandani made 53 off 63 balls, including seven boundaries.

title: ‘Conditions to be similar’: Gill on why NZ ODIs are crucial for 2027 WC plans
content: Shubman Gill, captain of the Indian cricket team, emphasizes the importance of the ODI series against New Zealand, seeing it as a crucial preparation for the World Cup. He’s arrived early to adapt to the red ball for enhanced performance. India currently leads the series and is eager to clinch a win in Wellington, while New Zealand eyes a robust comeback.

title: 'Stabbed 10 times': Chennai man kills wife with kitchen knife, surrenders
content: Vivek, a driver, surrendered at Neelankarai police station for stabbing his wife Muthupriya to death during a quarrel. The incident occurred at their rented house in Palavakkam, resulting in Muthupriya suffering ten stab wounds. After the murder, he left their daughter with his brother in Mudichur. Family members revealed Vivek had a history of mental health issues and had received treatment recently.

title: To ensure property goes to uncle, 2 relatives to kill 70-year-old woman in Bengaluru
content: A property dispute led to the murder of a 70-year-old woman in Bengaluru. The deceased, Venkatlakshmamma, was living alone after losing her husband and daughter. Relatives Kantharaju and Manjappa were arrested for attacking her over property disagreements. Police found clues suggesting that the murder was premeditated rather than a robbery gone wrong. Both suspects have confessed to their roles and remain in police custody.

title: Roads choke, cabs burn hole in pockets: Markets across Delhi teem with Diwali shoppers
content: Traffic congestion across Delhi increased significantly, especially around major markets during the Diwali shopping rush. Commuters faced delays on key roads, with some journey times stretching to nearly two hours. Cab fares saw a considerable increase due to high demand and restrictions on certain vehicles entering the city. Many commuters expressed their frustration regarding the traffic situation and rising transportation costs on social media.

title: OBC creamy layer row: SC protects past jobs, promotions; leaves pending cases open
content: The Supreme Court has clarified that its March ruling will not impact completed appointments or promotions. Cases still pending will be examined individually by the courts based on merit and eligibility. The government expressed concerns that retrospective application could unsettle established positions and admissions. It sought two years to establish a uniform creamy layer mechanism across various sectors.

title: Zelenskyy eyes bipartisan US backing amid Ukraine's Patriot shortage crisis
content: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy calls for a strategic shift in Ukraine's dealings with the United States, emphasizing the urgency of garnering bipartisan backing after the US midterm elections. He aims to reclaim essential military aid while stressing the immediate necessity for Patriot air defense missiles and the operational readiness of F-16 fighter jets as winter approaches.

title: Pakistan's external debt nearly doubles to $135 bn in 10 years, China biggest lender
content: Pakistan's external borrowing is projected to reach $135.1 billion by 2025, with much of the debt owed to China. The country's external debt increased from $68.673 billion in 2015 to the current level, reflecting a significant upward trend. Public and publicly-guaranteed borrowing comprises the majority of this debt, totaling around $107.076 billion. Private borrowing is notably more expensive, contributing to rising debt-service payments across developing countries.

title: 2nd-gen Gujaratis script history in US midterms
content: Seven Indian-American candidates achieved victories in the US midterm elections, marking a significant milestone for the community. Ami Bera won in California’s 6th Congressional District, securing his position as the longest-serving Congressman of Indian origin. Amish Shah became the first Indian origin person elected to Congress from Arizona’s 1st Congressional District, highlighting community advancement. Their campaigns focused on key issues like affordable healthcare and social security for constituents.

title: Indian rupee hits six-month high as foreign investors return to equities
content: The Indian rupee has reached a six-month high against the US dollar amidst changing investment trends. Foreign investors returned to Indian equities, purchasing nearly $3 billion in recent days. This shift comes as global markets facing losses reconsider their heavy exposure to technology stocks linked to AI. Lower crude oil prices have also provided relief to the Indian economy amid geopolitical developments.

title: Family massacre: Minor daughter assisted Bengaluru man at every stage of 7 killings
content: Indushekar is accused of murdering his wife and six of her relatives over domestic disputes. He reportedly disposed of the bodies in various locations, including near Nandi Hills. Police uncovered the case following a missing-person complaint filed by a relative of the victims. The accused's minor daughter is being questioned for her potential involvement in the crimes. Investigations are ongoing to locate the remaining bodies and verify the accused's claims.

title: SC ends decades-old power tussle, Himachal to get 11,973 MU from Punjab, Haryana
content: the BBMB has been providing Himachal Pradesh with its 7.19 per cent share of electricity from these projects since November 1, 2011 . however, Punjab and Haryana had not cleared the outstanding dues for the earlier period, amounting to 13,066 MU . a bench headed by Chief Justice of India Surya Kant, along with Justices Joymalya Bagchi and V Mohana, accepted the centre's proposal to clear the outstanding .
